title: Mixing: Don’t Let It Bring You Down by Wings | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

‘Don’t Let It Bring You Down’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town on 18 January 1978.

Following this session, the only songs on the album still requiring mixes were ‘I’ve Had Enough’ and ‘Morse Moose And The Grey Goose’.
